question: Can service rendered by an ignorant person yield a genuine result even when truth is present?
premises: Truth may be present in some respect.
Service may be performed by an ignorant person.
No fruit is observed from such service.
inference: Ignorant service does not produce the intended fruit despite the presence of truth.
uncertainties: The exact scope of phala in this context is not fully specified.
plain_english: Even if truth is present, no fruit is seen anywhere from what is served by an ignorant person.
